description: This file defines the 'AccessControlList' interface within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.things package. It models an ACL system for authorization, providing methods for managing entries, permissions, and related authorization subjects. It includes factory methods for ACL creation, merging, setting entries, and querying permissions. The interface is marked as deprecated and is part of an older API version.

classes.name: AccessControlList
classes.description: An interface representing an immutable Access Control List (ACL) for authorization management, with methods for manipulating entries, permissions, and permissions checks. It supports JSON serialization and is marked as deprecated in favor of newer policy-based API.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for constructing an immutable AccessControlList.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Produces a builder pre-initialized with the current ACL's entries for modification.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the JSON schema versions supported by this ACL, specifically version 1.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Adds an ACL entry by merging the provided AclEntry object; also merges permissions for an authorization subject.

methods.name: merge (overload)
methods.description: Creates a new ACL with additional permissions associated with an authorization subject.

methods.name: merge (another overload)
methods.description: Creates a new ACL associating a permission with multiple authorization subjects.

methods.name: setEntry
methods.description: Replaces or sets an entry for a specific authorization subject.

methods.name: setForAllAuthorizationSubjects
methods.description: Sets permissions uniformly for all authorization subjects in the ACL.

methods.name: getAuthorizedSubjectsFor (by permission)
methods.description: Retrieves a set of authorization subjects that hold at least the specified permissions.

methods.name: hasPermission (by context)
methods.description: Checks if any subject in the specified authorization context has at least the specified permissions.

methods.name: hasPermission (by subject)
methods.description: Checks if the specified authorization subject has at least the specified permissions.

methods.name: getAuthorizedSubjectsFor (by Permissions object)
methods.description: Retrieves authorization subjects associated with at least the specified permissions.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks whether the ACL contains permissions for the specified authorization subject.

methods.name: getEntryFor
methods.description: Returns the ACL entry associated with a specific authorization subject.

methods.name: getPermissionsOf
methods.description: Returns all permissions associated with a specific authorization subject.

methods.name: removeEntry
methods.description: Removes a specified ACL entry from the ACL.

methods.name: removePermission
methods.description: Removes specific permissions from an authorization subject's ACL entry.

methods.name: removeAllPermissionsOf
methods.description: Removes all permissions associated with a given authorization subject.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks whether the ACL has any entries.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the ACL.

methods.name: getEntriesSet
methods.description: Returns a modifiable set of all ACL entries; modifications do not affect the original ACL.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Creates a sequential stream of ACL entries.
